en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a rural valley framed by forested hills. In the foreground are a few houses with pitched roofs and leafless trees. In the middle stands an industrial-looking complex with long low buildings and a tall smokestack, likely a mill. To the left, partly hidden among the trees on a hill, is a stone tower and remains of a castle ruin. Printed text in red at the top identifies the location as Zöblitz in the Erzgebirge and mentions the castle mill with the Niederlauterstein castle ruins.
